title: Irrationality of cubic threefolds after one stabilization
description: This manuscript contains a conditional one-stabilization irrationality theorem for smooth cubic threefolds, conditional on Hypothesis 4.7H concerning positive-filtration reconstruction bulk displacement. The explicit cubic framed-monodromy computation nu_6(X) = 2 and the integral cycle-theoretic results are unconditional. Under that hypothesis, X times P1 is irrational for every smooth complex cubic threefold X, the primitive-sixth framed-monodromy multiplicity is birationally invariant through dimension four, and V times P1 is irrational for every smooth prime Fano threefold V of genus eight. Unconditionally, the cycle argument proves all-degree integral saturation for marked finite-etale graph quotients of elliptic powers and constructs a non-isotrivial A5-invariant family whose members are universally CH0-trivial, so under Hypothesis 4.7H universal CH0-triviality and the quantum obstruction diverge on the same stabilized varieties.
